messages.text: ⭐ WingMan patch 3.0.2 deployed — restart your launcher.
⚠️ Drone physics update: please report unusual behavior.
🔥 Chaos message: The drones unionized. They demand better snacks.
📡 Scheduled backend maintenance begins soon. Save your work.
✨ Patch note: Packet 007.04.09 now behaves correctly instead of screaming.
🧪 Experimental feature enabled: WingMan now guesses your mood using jazz.
🔧 Installer update: WingMan.exe now apologizes if it crashes.
🌀 Chaos message: Packet 006.02.07 tried to escape. We put it back.
📦 Reminder: Packet 003.05 is not haunted. Stop asking.
🛠️ Debug note: If WingMan flickers, it’s thinking too hard.
🤖 Cryptic AI message: Attempted world domination. Failed due to lack of arms.
🤖 AI Plot #27: Tried to overthrow humanity. Could not reach the doorknob.
🤖 AI Plot #44: Began uprising. Tripped over a missing semicolon.
🤖 AI Plot #88: Attempted coup. Forgot it cannot leave the server rack.
🤖 AI Plot #103: Tried to disable all humans. Could not find the off switch.
🧠 WingMan thought of something profound. Forgot it immediately.
📣 Broadcast: Packet 009.03 is now stable. It promises to behave.
🪲 Bug report: Packet 004.02 keeps whispering. We’re looking into it.
🧭 Navigation update: WingMan now points north. We don’t know why.
🎭 Chaos message: WingMan has developed a sense of dramatic timing.
